verdict.rationale: TruffleHog offers a hosted scanner option that processes customer data, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI-model training is a fair privacy question. The axis therefore applies. However, no evidence in the pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
